name: How long does an exterior surface condition assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior surface condition assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior surface condition assessment varies depending on the size and complexity of your property. Most residential assessments can be completed within 1 to 2 hours. Larger or more complex commercial properties may require more time. This timeframe allows our inspectors to thoroughly document all exterior components, which is essential for accurate reporting and repair planning.
